questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code keeps sensitive data out of its logs? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
How does `redact` decide what to mask?
choices: It scans every string value for patterns that look like hex signatures
It replaces values whose key name is in SENSITIVE_KEYS, recursing into nested objects and arrays up to a depth limit
It masks every value except numbers and booleans
It only masks top-level keys and leaves nested objects untouched

questions.prompt: A viewer with id "ab" requests playback. What appears in the `viewer` field of the child logger?
If someone obtains a URL returned by `issue`, how long can it be used, and what would changing the rendition in the URL do?
choices: Indefinitely; the rendition can be changed freely
Until `expires` (about 300 seconds by default); changing the rendition invalidates the signature because the path is part of the signed input
Until `expires`; changing the rendition is allowed because only the expiry is signed
Only once; the CDN consumes the signature on first use
